# Vendly.lk — E-commerce & Order Management Platform

> Vendly (https://vendly-lk.vercel.app/) is a cloud-based e-commerce operations, order management, inventory tracking, and courier COD reconciliation system built for merchants, retailers, and online sellers in Sri Lanka.

## Overview
Vendly streamlines multi-channel sales operations by connecting online orders (chatbots, social media, web storefronts) and physical walk-in retail sales into a single synchronized dashboard.

## Key Capabilities & Features

### 1. Unified Order Processing
- Online order processing with real-time customer status updates.
- Physical shop point-of-sale (POS) integration with instant stock updates.
- Automated waybill generation with barcode and QR code printing.
- Fraud risk detection and suspicious order warning flags.

### 2. Multi-Channel Inventory Management
- Real-time stock counts across multiple sizes, colors, and variant attributes.
- Multi-batch tracking with unit cost (FIFO) valuation.
- Low-stock alerts and out-of-stock reservation locks.
- Supplier and return stock adjustments.

### 3. Courier & COD Reconciliation
- Native tracking for courier partners in Sri Lanka (Prompt, Domex, Koombiyo, Fardar, Pronto, etc.).
- Cash-on-Delivery (COD) automated financial reconciliation.
- Settlement verification, courier charge auditing, and discrepancy dispute workflows.
- Single and bulk settlement entry recording.

### 4. Warranty & Claims Management
- Supplier warranty tracking with zero revenue loss allocation.
- In-house shop warranty and repair expense debiting.
- Live ledger debit calculation with courier transit expense tracking.

### 5. Financial Analytics & Business Intelligence
- Live profit & loss calculations per order and per product.
- Courier delivery performance ratings and return rate analysis.
- Sales revenue forecasting and customer repeat-rate metrics.
